edges.label: AFOSI investigated the 1980 intrusions at the nuclear weapons storage area
edges.note: The intrusions occurred at the Manzano Weapons Storage Area adjacent to Sandia National Laboratories; AFOSI ran the investigation and simultaneously ran the Bennewitz operation.

edges.label: Same service, both functions
edges.note: AFOSI is chartered for both counterintelligence and criminal investigation, and is the organisation named in the Bennewitz deception; the two domains share personnel.

b.label: AARO Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I

edges.label: AARO's 2024 historical review makes no mention of Bennewitz, Doty, AFOSI or Kirtland
edges.note: The best-documented instance of US government disinformation about UFOs directed at an American citizen is entirely absent from the government's own historical review of the subject.

edges.label: Bennewitz's reporting generated the AFOSI Kirtland file
edges.note: The 10 November 1980 AFOSI record documents Kirtland security police observations of unexplained objects over Coyote Canyon and notes Bennewitz's photography and reporting.

edges.label: Bennewitz founded and ran Thunder Scientific, a USAF instrumentation vendor
edges.note: The company's location gave sightlines to the Manzano Weapons Storage Area at Kirtland; Bennewitz had the technical capability to record and characterise emissions.

edges.label: Fabricated material as the delivery vehicle
edges.note: The Bennewitz episode, in which AFOSI personnel supplied fabricated documents, is the documented case linking perception management to forged records; Doty's own personnel file is public.

edges.label: Doty was the AFOSI special agent associated with the Kirtland UFO file
edges.note: Doty served in AFOSI at Kirtland from 1979 and is the agent identified with the Kirtland UFO documents and with the subsequent contact with Bennewitz and Howe.

b.label: Air Force Office of Special Investigations

edges.label: Documented AFOSI special agent at Kirtland, 1980
edges.note: Documented by the complaint form itself rather than by any of his own later accounts, which is the point: his service does not depend on the reliability of a self-described disinformation officer.

edges.label: Doty showed Howe a purported classified briefing paper at Kirtland, April 1983
edges.note: Howe's contemporaneous notes record being permitted to read but not copy a document describing retrieved craft and biological entities, with a promise of film footage that was never delivered.

edges.label: Two-sided: the reported admission, and his own recorded denial of harm
edges.note: The board already carries the admission side, reported by Alejandro Rojas on 13 May 2014 in a piece that paraphrases throughout and quotes him nowhere. This edge adds the half that was missing: on camera to George Knapp he calls the harm narrative false 'in every aspect' and says Bennewitz 'did this to himself'. Both are his. Neither can be graded above Tier 2 and the board should carry both rather than choosing.

edges.note: Doty's documented AFOSI activity - feeding fabricated alien-technology material to a target to protect classified programmes - is the same technique Yankee Blue applied internally to cleared personnel. The inference is about method, not about Doty's involvement in Yankee Blue.
